properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency of the Ethereum toolchain (via elliptic, which web3/truffle use for account signing); ships SHA-1/SHA-2/RIPEMD implementations with the build. No first-party require('hash.js') — the repo's own code hashes via web3.utils.sha3 (Keccak).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@3.1.9-1 is a transitive dependency of the truffle/ganache dev toolchain and bundles an MD5 implementation among its primitives. No first-party MD5 use found; the algorithm ships with the dependency tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@3.1.9-1 (same transitive dep as the MD5 object) bundles SHA-1. No first-party SHA-1 call found; algorithm availability is what is recorded.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ethereum signing stack: secp256k1@3.8.0 is a DIRECT dependency (package.json:29) and secp256k1/tiny-secp256k1 recur throughout the lockfile as the ECDSA-signing layer of web3/truffle/ganache/buidler. No first-party require('secp256k1') — first-party scripts sign through web3.eth.accounts instead. The secp256k1 curve is fixed by the Ethereum protocol: replaceable only by a protocol-wide PQ migration, not per-application.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Non-cryptographic randomness used only to generate fuzz trade parameters and pick test branches in truffle tests; no keys, nonces, tokens or secrets derive from it. The "security context" framing does not apply — exposure is test reproducibility, not secret generation.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared transitive dependency (required by browserify-aes/browserify-cipher in the crypto-browserify stack web3 1.2.4 pulls in). Implements OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey — a single-round MD5 KDF deriving cipher keys from passwords. Ships in the dependency tree; no first-party call site in the application.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency (via sshpk/http-signature in the ganache-cli request stack) implementing OpenBSD bcrypt_pbkdf — the bcrypt-algorithm-based KDF used to decrypt OpenSSH-format private keys. Note it is bcrypt_pbkdf (a KDF), not the bcrypt password hash itself; the bcrypt family is nonetheless in the tree. Metadata only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared transitive dependency in the crypto-browserify stack used by web3's browser crypto shim — classical ECDH key agreement ships in the dependency tree and is retroactively breakable (Shor); migration X25519MLKEM768 hybrid when it matters. Metadata only; no first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signing available in the shipped dependency tree (transitive dep of the ganache-cli/ethereumjs stack). No first-party call site — presence is the inventory fact; capability changes only with the dependency chain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.3 is a transitive dependency (web3/truffle account stack) providing ECDSA over secp256k1/P-256. No first-party import; the toolchain uses it for transaction signing when tests/deployers call web3.eth.accounts.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 key agreement available in the shipped dependency tree via tweetnacl@1.0.3. No first-party call site. Classical ECDH — Shor-vulnerable; migration target ML-KEM-768 when a use appears.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak/SHA-3 libraries (keccak, keccakjs, @ethersproject/keccak256) declared throughout package-lock.json as the hashing layer of the web3/ethers Ethereum stack — plus the direct 'sha3'@2.1.1 dependency in package.json, which no first-party code imports. The repo's own code hashes through web3.utils.sha3 (see separate findings). Dependency inventory: the algorithm ships with the build's toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared transitive dependencies: scrypt-js 2.0.3/2.0.4/3.0.1 (memory-hard KDF used by the ethereumjs/web3 account stack to encrypt keystore files) and web3's scrypt-shim browser replacement. Metadata only; no first-party call site. The scrypt-js package is also tracked as a library object on the other shard.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @ethersproject/pbkdf2 and pbkdf2@3.x are transitive dependencies — the keystore/mnemonic/HD-wallet derivation layer of ethers@5 and ganache-cli. No first-party PBKDF2 call exists in the repo's own code; the KDF ships with the dev/test toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES available via crypto-js@3.1.9-1, a transitive dependency used internally by web3 1.2.4 (account/keystore crypto). No first-party call site. Note: crypto-js 3.x derives its keys via EvpKDF (single-round MD5) — see the EVP_BytesToKey object for that weakness.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Symmetric authenticated encryption available in the shipped tree via tweetnacl@1.0.3; no first-party call site. Grover halves the 256-bit design to 128-bit security; not Shor-broken. Changeable only via the dependency chain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider in the dependency inventory: tweetnacl@1.0.3 ships Ed25519, X25519 and XSalsa20-Poly1305 to the ganache-cli/ethereumjs stack this build uses. No first-party import in application code — the algorithms ship with the library regardless.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider in the dependency inventory: web3 1.2.4 pulls crypto-js 3.1.9-1 internally (AES, EvpKDF/MD5, MD5/SHA digests, HMAC). No first-party import; the algorithms ship in the tree and their weaknesses (MD5-based EvpKDF) are inherited.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@2.0.4 is a transitive dependency of the Ethereum keystore layer (web3/ganache wallet encryption). No first-party scrypt call; ships with the dev toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js@2.4.11 is a transitive dependency of the Ethereum toolchain (create-hash/browserify stack used by web3/truffle); pure-JS SHA-2 implementations. No first-party import.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.3 — the ECDSA/ECDH implementation backing web3's account layer. Transitive dependency; no first-party import; presence is what is recorded.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 — hash primitive implementations, transitive via elliptic in the web3/truffle signing stack. No first-party import.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.0.17 — Node pbkdf2 (browserify-compatible), transitive dependency of the ethers/ganache wallet layer. No first-party KDF call.
